title: ItemDefIr
description: A Bedrock item definition, 44 components. SC-170. Mojang rewrote the shape at 1.20.50, moving all behaviour under components; the IR models the modern shape and older files upgrade into it (SC-110 section 3.2). Registration is SC-120 section 4: one carrier Item, identity in a data component.

components.description: Keys are Bedrock component names. Component availability is gated by format_version upstream (minecraft:compostable needs 1.21.60, minecraft:cooldown needs 1.20.10); a component used below its gate is SCE-2040 and is kept, because Bedrock's own enforcement is inconsistent.

legacy.description: Fields from the pre-1.20.50 shape that have no modern equivalent, preserved so an upgrade transform is auditable.

attachable.description: Resolved reference to the attachable definition that gives this item a 3D held or worn model. Attachables live in the resource pack but belong to the item (SC-170 section 1).

vanillaFallback.description: Wire carrier item. SC-270 section 4. Distinct from the SERVER-side carrier, which is always sweetcookie:item.
